visible.title: streamlit please wait forever python
visible.body:
### Summary

After deploying on the server "stream hello", the browser opens up  please wait
and  please wait forever python 
How to operate this?

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: (get it with `$ streamlit version`)1.13.0
- Python version: (get it with `$ python --version`) 3.8.0
- Using Conda? PipEnv? PyEnv? Pex? Conda

gold.summary: 'streamlit hello' deployed on a server shows 'Please wait...' forever (v1.13).
hypotheses: accessing wrong address/port or proxy not forwarding /stream

missing_info.item: how the app is accessed (direct IP:port vs reverse proxy / LB)
missing_info.why: proxy without websocket upgrade is the most common cause

missing_info.item: browser console / network errors for the websocket
missing_info.why: confirms websocket failure vs script error

acceptable_next_steps: Ask how it is accessed and for console errors
Point to the 'App is not loading when running remotely' KB article
gold.reference: Maintainer: not enough info, no known issue; asked if own app runs; closed as unactionable.
